hero.headline: Simplify your condominium management
hero.subheadline: A modern platform for syndics and co-owners. Payments, meetings, charges — all in one place.

buildings.title: Building management
buildings.description: Track your buildings, apartments and units with a centralized, hierarchical view.

owners.title: Co-owners
owners.description: Manage profiles, ownership shares and invite owners to their portal.

payments.title: Payments & Charges
payments.description: Generate charge calls, record payments and track receivables in real time.

meetings.title: Meetings & Minutes
meetings.description: Schedule assemblies, draft agendas and archive meeting minutes.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.description: Key indicators, collection rates and payment trends at a glance.

security.title: Security & Audit

cta.heading: Ready to modernize your management?
cta.description: Join the syndics who have chosen a simple, secure and efficient solution.

howItWorks.heading: Three simple steps
howItWorks.step1Description: Register your building, add apartments and configure your syndic settings in minutes.
howItWorks.step2Description: Create accounts — they automatically receive an email with access credentials to their personal portal.
howItWorks.step3Description: Issue charges, track payments, organize assemblies and receive instant notifications via Supabase Realtime.
